name: context-pocket
description: Zero-dependency CLI + MCP server that auto-records every AI coding conversation turn into a project-local ContextPocket/ folder of plain Markdown, so any agent or model can pick the context back up in seconds.
author: ContextPocket Contributors

scripts.lint: node -e "var fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process'),skip={'node_modules':1,'dist':1,'build':1,'coverage':1};function walk(d){var out=[];fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).forEach(function(e){if(skip[e.name]||e.name.charAt(0)==='.')return;var p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){out=out.concat(walk(p));}else if(e.name.endsWith('.js')){out.push(p);}});return out;}var files=walk('.');if(files.length===0){throw new Error('lint: no .js file found');}files.forEach(function(p){cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',p],{stdio:'inherit'});});console.log('lint ok: syntax-checked '+files.length+' js file(s)');"
